pr_title: Fix perfect mod incorrectly failing in some scenarios
pr_body:
Prereqs:
- [x] https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/8066
- [x] new framework release

Fixes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/8078
pr_comments:
CI is failing, because at the end of tests, upon gameplay completion there is an attempt to import the score:

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/fd16d24362ac1ed98f05e9b6942475bc9962c639/osu.Game/Screens/Play/Player.cs#L618-L625

and sqlite is eating a foreign key exception (haven't checked exactly why, but I'd bet it's due to violating constraints on either `BeatmapSetInfo` or `BeatmapInfo`).

Seeing that `ReplayPlayer` is a thing already I'd say it might be best to allow `Player` inheritors to specify their own logic on completion, defaulting to import.
I agree with that direction. If you're already deep enough that you can easily commit the fix as proposed, you're welcome to go ahead!

So I started to implement that but then found these and facepalmed *very* hard at my blindness:

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/9c5e3942adee2afe2d49394ef7081c7a622ce32c/osu.Game/Screens/Play/Player.cs#L107-L111

Sort of eh that these flags are so easy to miss but I guess if they're there already might as well set them and call it a day?
It's weird that we do flags in three ways (ctor / settable props / overridden virtual props). Makes discovery hard.
I passed in that flag and also fixed up another issue that would cause the tests to not do what they intended to (explanation in commit msg of c803de2). Seems good otherwise 👍

issue_context.title: Perfect mod checks ignore judgements incorrectly
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 

When I got a GREAT I lose with perfect mode

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 

https://youtu.be/Zs18Z9X8bz8

**osu!lazer version:** 

2020.229.1

**Logs:**
*please attach logs here, which are located at:*
- `%AppData%/osu/logs` *(on Windows),*
- `~/.local/share/osu/logs` *(on Linux & macOS).*
Android
comments: This is actually another regression from #7973. `IgnoreJudgement` has a `MaxResult` of `HitResult.Perfect`, but perfects aren't a thing in standard.
Perfect is GREATs, so why if I get a GREAT which is the highest "grade" we can get can make us lose. Especially at the end of a slider. On a EASY map.
Perfects in _code_ nomenclature are mania- and catch-exclusive. As I said this is an actual bug that needs fixing. And please, drop the attitude.

review_comments: Do you have anything in mind for this for the future? As far as I can see this is always `true`, and I can't really see much usage opportunity in having this.
It's actually `false` in one case in `TestSceneCatchModPerfect`. Taiko should do the same, however it's a little hard to test drumroll ticks by themselves right now.
Same with spinner bonus ticks when they're implemented.
